CustomField.description: Deterministic identity of the Platform Event, composed by CursorBatchReplayGuard. Unique, so inserting a second row for the same event fails with DUPLICATE_VALUE -- that failure is how a redelivery is detected. Format is channel-prefixed: W#jobRecordId#cursorQueryId#workerNumber, C#jobRecordId#coordinatorClass, or jobRecordId#replayId for the completion channel. A key longer than 255 characters is replaced by its SHA-256 digest; the components remain readable in their own fields.
CustomField.label: Event Key
